name: Mailchimp
description: An all-in-one marketing, automation, and email platform that allows businesses to manage mailing lists, create campaigns, and track customer engagement.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp supports both OAuth 2.0 and API keys for authentication.
Mailchimp provides a comprehensive REST Marketing API (v3.0).
Community-built MCP servers exist for Mailchimp Marketing API integration.

notes: Mailchimp offers a robust REST Marketing API supporting API keys for internal scripts/server-side tools and OAuth 2.0 for user-facing applications and integrations.
